name: whoami
description: Claude Code mod: shows which Claude account, organization and plan the session uses and how much of the usage limit is left, and holds prompts in a folder pinned to another account.

fiveHourLimit.title: Show the 5-hour limit
fiveHourLimit.description: On: the footer shows how much of the 5-hour usage limit is used, and when it resets.

weeklyLimit.title: Show the weekly limit
weeklyLimit.description: always: the footer always shows the weekly usage limit. over-half: only once it is 50% used. never: it is not shown.
